articles.title: Optimizing AI Agent Planning with Operations Research and Data Science
articles.summary_raw:
AI agents can quickly become expensive without a clear strategy for planning, skill coverage, and budgets. This article shows how to use operations research and data science to optimize AI agent cost and resource allocation. You will learn how to frame common agent problems—skill coverage, project assignment, and budgeting—as set covering, assignment, and knapsack optimization models in Python using Gurobi.

The post

articles.reason: AI 도구 활용 방안과 함께 구체적인 최적화 전략을 포함하고 있어 실용적임.

articles.title: Anonymizing Production Data for Data Science with Mimesis
articles.summary_raw: Learn how to utilize Python's Mimesis library for anonymizing sensitive production data, based on a step-by-step example to try yourself.

articles.reason: 실제로 데이터 분석가가 사용할 수 있는 방법을 제공함.
